rtt_slots: Goal: Wake up at 7:00 every day, including weekends, to keep your wake-up time consistent. Limit caffeine intake to before 2:00 PM. Turn off all screens 30 minutes before bedtime. Here, the key is that exposure to light inhibits the onset of melatonin secretion. If you cannot fall asleep after 20 minutes, get up, engage in an activity in dim lighting, and then try again. Strengthen your circadian rhythm anchor by getting 10 minutes of sunlight in the morning. Expect it to take 1–2 weeks to adjust.
